titles.title: For the Rest of My Life!

description:
Lee Seung-yeon has been harboring a one-sided crush on his childhood friend, Gong Ji-hyuk.

Then one day, he hears a saying that a person could live happily for a lifetime on just a single memory. Seung-yeon finds himself wanting to create that one single memory with Ji-hyuk that he can cherish forever, but at the same time, he is terrified that they might ultimately break up and become strangers….

*“Can you give me just a single day out of your entire life?”*

In the end, Seung-yeon asks Ji-hyuk to date him for just one day. *(Source: Bomtoon, translated)*
